scope: four-video DAVIS object-only leave-one-video-out replication of the 2026-09-27 joint-decoder probe
graph: observed t0 query UV, symmetric 2D kNN k=3; all 48 query nodes; no future-validity pruning
time_basis: consecutive DAVIS source frame indices; preview MP4 24 fps is not used
exploratory_signal: joint_relational improves both primary metrics against P0 and joint_node_control on at least 3 of 4 held-out videos by five-seed medians; raw ADE does not rise more than 5% on those videos
quality_gate: all four videos must pass fixed identity, t0 anchor, validity, 3D cross-fit registration, finite-output, and connected-graph checks before training
known_limits: DAVIS provides RGB and 2D masks but no true 3D trajectory ground truth
TrackCraft3R full-22-frame trajectories are offline pseudo-labels
source capture timestamps are unavailable; consecutive source frame indices define the experiment time grid
MotionForesight is frozen and future RGB frames never enter its prediction conditions
only four independent videos; initialization seeds do not increase independent video count
